description: Implementation of the AudioFrameDiscarder class, handling audio buffer input, adjusting for discarded durations, and managing end-of-stream and reset operations within the starboard::shared::starboard::player::filter namespace.

classes.name: AudioFrameDiscarder
classes.description: Class responsible for managing audio frame discarding and timestamp adjustments in the media pipeline.

methods.name: OnInputBuffers
methods.description: Processes incoming input buffers, storing their timestamps and discarded durations.

methods.name: AdjustForDiscardedDurations
methods.description: Adjusts the decoded audio data based on previously stored discarded durations, considering timestamp consistency.

methods.name: OnDecodedAudioEndOfStream
methods.description: Handles end-of-stream event, logging if there are pending input buffer infos.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets internal state, clearing stored input buffer information.
